justifications.text: Uses PlayerVox OverCrow's Twitch connection, read only, with three read permissions: your goals (channel:read:goals), followers (moderator:read:followers) and Hype Trains (channel:read:hype_train), and their live events on your channel. The widget never sees the token: PlayerVox OverCrow adds it to the four routes below, on api.twitch.tv only. Nothing is written to Twitch, and nothing read is stored.
Reads the ID of your channel (no permission needed), once per connection; the other routes ask for that channel.

Reads your channel's active goals and their progress (channel:read:goals). Once when the live events start or one was missed, and every 20 seconds while they are off and the widget is shown, when the options show goals; once a minute at most while Twitch fails.

Reads your follower count and the latest follower, one at a time (first=1; moderator:read:followers). Once when the live events start or one was missed, and every 20 seconds while they are off and the widget is shown, when the options show followers; once a minute at most while Twitch fails.

Reads whether a Hype Train runs on your channel, its level, progress and end (channel:read:hype_train). Once when the live events start or one was missed, and every 20 seconds while they are off and the widget is shown, when the options show the Hype Train; once a minute at most while Twitch fails.
